desc:
Drupal integrations with CRM and single sign-on connect your site to the tools your team already uses. Ecom Swift LLC builds each link on a staging copy and tests it with sample data, so information moves without copying and pasting.

## What are Drupal integrations?

A Drupal integration is a connection between your website and another system, so data or actions pass between them automatically. Common examples are form entries that arrive in a CRM, a search engine such as Solr or Algolia that answers queries faster than the built-in search, a sign-in that uses your company account, and a payment gateway for orders or donations.

Without these links, staff retype enquiries, visitors search poorly and customers manage separate accounts. Each manual step is slow and invites mistakes.

## Why a tested connection matters

A broken integration is worse than none. A form that appears to work but never reaches the CRM costs you leads without any visible error. A sign-in set up carelessly can lock out real users or let in the wrong ones. A payment link that fails at the last step loses the order.

That is why we test each connection from end to end before launch. We submit sample entries, watch where they land, trigger errors on purpose and confirm that someone is told when a send fails.

## How integrations improve results

Speed and accuracy are the main gains. When an enquiry lands in your CRM within moments, your team can reply while the visitor is still interested. When fields are mapped correctly, records are clean and reports are trustworthy. A better search helps visitors find content, which keeps them on the site longer and helps them reach the page they need.

Single sign-on reduces the number of passwords people must manage, which cuts support requests and the risk of weak, reused passwords. Staff time freed from data entry can go to work that needs a person.

## What a good integration includes

- A written agreement on which data moves, in which direction, and when.
- A field mapping sheet that shows each Drupal field and its matching field in the other tool.
- An existing, maintained module used wherever one fits, with custom code only where nothing suitable exists.
- Credentials stored safely in site configuration rather than in page content.
- Testing on staging with sample data before the live site is touched.
- Error alerts by email, so a failed send is noticed.
- Retry handling for sends that fail temporarily.
- A short setup note describing how it works and how to change it.
- For single sign-on, clear rules on which users get which roles.
- A handover so your team knows who to call when a vendor changes something.

## What we do

We start with a short discussion of the tool, the data and the trigger. We then choose between an existing Drupal module and a custom link through the tool's API, and we explain the choice. On staging we install and configure the link, map the fields and run tests with sample records.

The Basic package covers one integration. Standard covers two, with alerts and a mapping sheet. Premium covers more tools and can include single sign-on, a payment gateway or a custom API link where no module exists, plus retry handling and a handover call. When the tests pass and you approve, we repeat the setup on the live site.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Decide in advance which tool holds the master record for each type of data.
- Create a test account in the outside tool for us to use.
- Name one person who owns the integration after launch.
- Keep a list of every connected tool and what it receives.
- Tell us about any rules on handling personal data.

**Avoid:**
- Sending every field to the CRM when you only need a few.
- Using one shared login for both people and automated sends.
- Skipping error alerts, since silent failures are the costly kind.
- Changing field names in the outside tool without telling anyone.
- Connecting a payment tool without testing a refund and a failed card.

## Who this is for

This suits a sales team that wants web enquiries to appear in HubSpot or another CRM automatically. It suits an organization with a large content library that needs better search, and a company that wants staff or members to sign in with an existing company login.

## What we need from you

Tell us which tool you want to connect and what should happen between it and your site. Give us a test account for that tool and a staging copy of your Drupal site if one exists. We work as a developer or administrator user in your account and never ask for passwords. You pay the outside tools directly, since our price covers the work only.
